title: Day 5 - Lists and For Loops Super Easy Quiz

questions.question_text: Which brackets do we use to make a list in Python?
Which one is a Python list?

What will this code print?

```python
pets = ["dog", "cat"]
print(pets)
```
Python starts counting list indexes from what number?

What will this code print?

```python
colors = ["red", "blue", "green"]
print(colors[0])
```

What will this code print?

```python
colors = ["red", "blue", "green"]
print(colors[2])
```
What does `append()` do to a list?
options: Adds an item to the end

questions.question_text:
What will this code print?

```python
books = ["math", "art"]
books.append("music")
print(books)
```
What does `len()` tell us about a list?
options: How many items are in the list
The first item in the list
The last item in the list

questions.question_text:
What will this code print?

```python
numbers = [8, 9, 10]
print(len(numbers))
```

What will this code print?

```python
toys = ["ball"]
toys.append("kite")
print(len(toys))
```
Can a list store different kinds of values, like text, numbers, and True or False?
Which line starts a `for` loop correctly?

What will this code print?

```python
names = ["Noy", "Lee"]
for name in names:
    print(name)
```
